description.value: Perfecto is an artisan cafe on Robson Street in Vancouver that produces all its pastries, cakes, sandwiches, and gelato from scratch daily in a central kitchen using quality ingredients. The cafe uses a custom coffee blend developed exclusively with Agro Roasters, and its gelato is crafted by a Maestro trained at the Carpigiani Gelato University in Italy. It is one of four Perfecto locations across Vancouver and Burnaby, making it a recognizable and reliable stop along a popular urban cycling corridor.
